# Velmeshev 2019

#### Create Seurat object
```{r}
counts <- ReadMtx(
  mtx = paste0(data.dir, 'Velmeshev_2019_Autism/', 'rawMatrix/', 'matrix.mtx'), 
  features = paste0(data.dir, 'Velmeshev_2019_Autism/', 'rawMatrix/', 'genes.tsv'),
  cells = paste0(data.dir, 'Velmeshev_2019_Autism/', 'rawMatrix/', 'barcodes.tsv')
)

metadata.df <- read.csv(paste0(data.dir, 'Velmeshev_2019_Autism/', 'rawMatrix/', 'meta.txt'), sep="\t")
rownames(metadata.df) <- metadata.df$cell

seurat.obj <- CreateSeuratObject(counts = counts)
seurat.obj <- AddMetaData(seurat.obj, metadata.df)

get.l1.cell.types <- function(x) {
  if (x %in% c("AST-FB", "AST-PP", "OPC", "Oligodendrocytes")) {
    return("Glial")
  } else if (x %in% c("Neu-NRGN-I", "Neu-NRGN-II", "Neu-mat", "IN-PV", "IN-SST", "IN-SV2C", "IN-VIP", "L2/3", "L4", "L5/6", "L5/6-CC")) {
    return("Neurons")
  } else if (x == "Microglia") {
    return("Immune")
  } else if (x == "Endothelial") {
    return("Vascular")
  } else {
    stop(paste('unknown cell type', x))
  }
}

get.l2.cell.types <- function(x) {
  if (x %in% c("AST-FB", "AST-PP")) {
    return("Astrocytes")
  } else if (x %in% c("IN-PV", "IN-SST", "IN-SV2C", "IN-VIP")) {
    return("Inhibitory neurons")
  } else if (x %in% c("L2/3", "L4", "L5/6", "L5/6-CC", "Neu-mat", "Neu-NRGN-I", "Neu-NRGN-II")) {
    return("Excitatory neurons")
  } else if (x == "Microglia") {
    return("Myeloid")
  } else if (x == "Endothelial") {
    return("Vascular")
  } else if (x == "OPC") { 
    return("OPC")
  } else if (x == "Oligodendrocytes") {
    return("Oligodendrocytes")
  } else {
    stop(paste('unknown cell type', x))
  }
}

seurat.obj$annotation_l1 <- sapply(seurat.obj$cluster, function(x) get.l1.cell.types(x))
seurat.obj$annotation_l2 <- sapply(seurat.obj$cluster, function(x) get.l2.cell.types(x))
seurat.obj$annotation_l3 <- seurat.obj$cluster

seurat.obj <- NormalizeData(seurat.obj)
seurat.obj[["percent.mt"]] <- PercentageFeatureSet(seurat.obj, pattern = "^MT-")

# very low quality cells (none for Velmeshev 2019 because I think it was already filtered)
seurat.obj$filter.out <- apply(seurat.obj@meta.data, 1, function(row) (as.numeric(row[['nCount_RNA']]) < nCount_RNA.cutoff.filter.out) | (as.numeric(row[['percent.mt']]) > percent.mt.cutoff.filter.out))

# low quality cells
seurat.obj$low.quality.by.qc <- apply(seurat.obj@meta.data, 1, function(row) (as.numeric(row[['nCount_RNA']]) < nCount_RNA.cutoff.low) | (as.numeric(row[['nFeature_RNA']]) < nFeature_RNA.cutoff.low) | (as.numeric(row[['percent.mt']]) > percent.mt.cutoff))
  

seurat.obj$annotation_l1.w.qc <- apply(seurat.obj@meta.data, 1, function(row) ifelse(row[["filter.out"]], "Filtered out", ifelse(row[["low.quality.by.qc"]], "Low quality", row[["annotation_l1"]])))
seurat.obj$annotation_l2.w.qc <- apply(seurat.obj@meta.data, 1, function(row) ifelse(row[["filter.out"]], "Filtered out", ifelse(row[["low.quality.by.qc"]], "Low quality", row[["annotation_l2"]])))
seurat.obj$annotation_l3.w.qc <- apply(seurat.obj@meta.data, 1, function(row) ifelse(row[["filter.out"]], "Filtered out", ifelse(row[["low.quality.by.qc"]], "Low quality", row[["annotation_l3"]])))


saveRDS(seurat.obj, paste0(data.dir, 'Velmeshev_2019_Autism/', 'SeuratObjects/', 'raw.velmeshev2019.autism.all.cells.seurat.obj.RDS'))

unique(seurat.obj$diagnosis)
print(dim(seurat.obj))
seurat.obj.subset <- subset(seurat.obj, subset = diagnosis == 'Control')
print(dim(seurat.obj.subset))

saveRDS(seurat.obj.subset, paste0(data.dir, 'Velmeshev_2019_Autism/', 'SeuratObjects/', 'raw.velmeshev2019.autism.control.only.seurat.obj.RDS'))

print('done!')
```



# Process Seurat object control only
```{r process seurat obj}
for (clean in c('before.clean', 'after.clean')) { # 'after.clean'
  print(clean)
  
  seurat.obj <- readRDS(paste0(data.dir, 'Velmeshev_2019_Autism/', 'SeuratObjects/', 'raw.velmeshev2019.autism.control.only.seurat.obj.RDS'))
  print(dim(seurat.obj))
  
  seurat.obj <- subset(seurat.obj, subset = low.quality.by.qc == FALSE) # remove low quality
  
  # cell cycle scoring
  s.genes <- cc.genes$s.genes
  g2m.genes <- cc.genes$g2m.genes
  seurat.obj <- CellCycleScoring(seurat.obj, s.features = s.genes, g2m.features = g2m.genes)
  
  seurat.obj <- NormalizeData(seurat.obj)
  seurat.obj <- FindVariableFeatures(seurat.obj)
  
  seurat.obj <- add.module.score(seurat.obj, gene.signatures)
  
  if (clean == "after.clean") {
    seurat.obj <- ScaleData(seurat.obj, vars.to.regress = denoise.vars.to.regress)
  } else {
    seurat.obj <- ScaleData(seurat.obj)
  }
  
  set.seed(123)
  seurat.obj <- RunPCA(seurat.obj)
  ElbowPlot(seurat.obj, ndims = 50)
  seurat.obj <- RunUMAP(seurat.obj, dims=1:20, return.model = T)

  p1 <- DimPlot(seurat.obj, group.by='annotation_l1', label=T, shuffle=T)
  p2 <- DimPlot(seurat.obj, group.by='annotation_l2', label=T, shuffle=T)
  p3 <- DimPlot(seurat.obj, group.by='annotation_l3', label=T, shuffle=T)
  p4 <- DimPlot(seurat.obj, group.by='individual', label=F, shuffle=T) + NoLegend()
  p5 <- DimPlot(seurat.obj, group.by='sample', label=F, shuffle=T) + NoLegend()
  p6 <- DimPlot(seurat.obj, group.by='diagnosis', label=F, shuffle=T)
  p7 <- DimPlot(seurat.obj, group.by='sex', label=F, shuffle=T)
  p8 <- DimPlot(seurat.obj, group.by='region', label=F, shuffle=T)
  p9 <- DimPlot(seurat.obj, group.by='Seqbatch', label=F, shuffle=T)
  p10 <- DimPlot(seurat.obj, group.by='Capbatch', label=F, shuffle=T)
  p11 <- DimPlot(seurat.obj, group.by='Phase', label=F, shuffle=T)
  p12 <- DimPlot(seurat.obj, group.by='low.quality.by.qc', label=F, shuffle=T)
  p <- p1 + p2 + p3 + p4 + p5 + p6 + p7 + p8 + p9 + p10 + p11 + p12
  pdf(paste0(results.dir, 'Velmeshev2019Autism/', clean, '.control.only.UMAP.pdf'), width=28, height=14)
  print(p)
  dev.off()
  
  cells.order.random <- sample(Cells(seurat.obj))
  p <- FeaturePlot(seurat.obj, features=c('post.mortem.interval..hours.', 'RNA.mitochondr..percent', 'percent.mt', 'RNA.ribosomal.percent', 'RNA.Integrity.Number', 'age', 'nFeature_RNA', 'postmortem.signature', 'heat.shock.signature', 'postmortem.sensitive', 'postmortem.glial'), cells = cells.order.random)
  pdf(paste0(results.dir, 'Velmeshev2019Autism/', clean, '.control.only.FeaturePlot.UMAP.pdf'), width=24, height=12)
  print(p)
  dev.off()
  
  saveRDS(seurat.obj, paste0(data.dir, 'Velmeshev_2019_Autism/', 'SeuratObjects/', clean, '.velmeshev2019.autism.control.only.seurat.obj.RDS'))
}
print('done!')
```

# functions for standardizing cell type
get.l1.cell.types <- function(x) {
  if (x %in% c("Astro", "Oligo", "OPC")) {
    return("Glial")
  } else if (x %in% c("L2-3_CUX2", "L4_RORB", "L5-6_THEMIS", "L5-6_TLE4", "PN_dev", "CGE_dev", "ID2", "LAMP5_NOS1", "MGE_dev", "PV", "PV_SCUBE3", "SST", "VIP")) {
    return("Neurons")
  } else if (x == "Micro") {
    return("Immune")
  } else if (x == "Vas") {
    return("Vascular")
  } else if (x == "Poor-Quality") {
    return("Poor.Quality")
  } else {
    stop(paste('unknown cell type', x))
  }
}
  
get.l2.cell.types <- function(x) {
  if (x %in% c("Astro")) {
    return("Astrocytes")
  } else if (x %in% c("CGE_dev", "ID2", "LAMP5_NOS1", "MGE_dev", "PV", "PV_SCUBE3",  "SST", "VIP")) {
    return("Inhibitory neurons")
  } else if (x %in% c("L2-3_CUX2", "L4_RORB", "L5-6_THEMIS", "L5-6_TLE4", "PN_dev")) {
    return("Excitatory neurons")
  } else if (x == "Micro") {
    return("Myeloid")
  } else if (x == "Vas") {
    return("Vascular")
  } else if (x == "Oligo") { 
    return("Oligodendrocytes")
  } else if (x == "OPC") {
    return("OPC")
  } else if (x == "Poor-Quality") {
    return("Poor.Quality")
  } else {
    stop(paste('unknown cell type', x))
  }
}



herring.2022.supp.metadata <- readxl::read_excel(paste0(data.dir, 'Herring_2022/', 'TableS1_1-s2.0-S0092867422012582-mmc1.xlsx'), sheet = "sample.metadata.JP.modified")

files <- list.files(paste0(data.dir, 'Herring_2022/', 'GSE168408_RAW/'))
seurat.obj.list <- list()
for (f in files) {
  print(f)
  counts <- Read10X_h5(filename = paste0(data.dir, 'Herring_2022/', 'GSE168408_RAW/', f))
  seurat.obj <- CreateSeuratObject(counts = counts)
  seurat.obj <- NormalizeData(seurat.obj)
  seurat.obj[["percent.mt"]] <- PercentageFeatureSet(seurat.obj, pattern = "^MT-")
  geo.sample.id <- unlist(str_split(f, "_"))[1]
  library.id <- unlist(str_split(f, "_"))[2]
  age <- unlist(str_split(f, "_"))[3]
  seurat.obj$geo.sample.id_ <- geo.sample.id # _ denotes I added while making seurat object
  seurat.obj$library.id_ <- library.id
  seurat.obj$age_ <- age
  
  organoid <- unlist(str_split(f, "_"))[4]
  if (organoid == 'organoid') {
    is.sample.organoid <- TRUE
    PMI <- NA
  } else {
    is.sample.organoid <- FALSE
    temp <- herring.2022.supp.metadata %>% filter(`snRNA-seq library ID` == library.id)
    PMI <- temp$PMI
  }
  
  seurat.obj$is.sample.organoid_ <- is.sample.organoid
  seurat.obj$PMI_ <- PMI
  
  Idents(seurat.obj) <- 'library.id_'
  
  #saveRDS(seurat.obj, paste0(data.dir, 'Herring_2022/', 'processed/', library.id, '.seurat.obj.RDS'))
  
  #seurat.obj.downsample <- subset(seurat.obj, subset = library.id_ == library.id, downsample = 1000)
  seurat.obj.list[[library.id]] <- seurat.obj#seurat.obj.downsample
}

  temp <- unlist(str_split(x, "-"))
  barcode <- temp[1]
  library.id <- unlist(str_split(temp[2], "_"))[1]
  return(paste0(library.id, "_", barcode, "-1"))
}

#### Process data
```{r}

for (clean in c('before.clean', 'after.clean')) { # 'after.clean'
  
  print(clean)
  
  seurat.obj <- readRDS(paste0(data.dir, 'Herring_2022/', 'processed/', 'all.sampled.merged.seurat.obj.RDS'))
  
  # remove poor-quality, only keep cells that have metadata
  seurat.obj <- subset(seurat.obj, subset = (cell_type != 'Poor-Quality') & (no.published.metadata == FALSE) & (low.quality.by.qc == FALSE))
  
  seurat.obj <- NormalizeData(seurat.obj)
  seurat.obj <- FindVariableFeatures(seurat.obj)
  
  seurat.obj <- add.module.score(seurat.obj, gene.signatures)
  
  if (clean == "after.clean") {
    seurat.obj <- ScaleData(seurat.obj, vars.to.regress = denoise.vars.to.regress)
  } else {
    seurat.obj <- ScaleData(seurat.obj)
  }
  
  set.seed(123)
  seurat.obj <- RunPCA(seurat.obj)
  ElbowPlot(seurat.obj, ndims = 50)
  seurat.obj <- RunUMAP(seurat.obj, dims=1:20, return.model = T)
  
  seurat.obj$Oxygen.No.Oxygen <- sapply(seurat.obj$Oxygen.No.Oxygen, function(x) ifelse(x == "No oxygen", "No Oxygen", x))
  cells.order.random <- sample(Cells(seurat.obj))
  
  p.library <- DimPlot(seurat.obj, group.by = 'library.id_', shuffle=T)
  p.individual <- DimPlot(seurat.obj, group.by = 'geo.sample.id_', shuffle=T)
  p.stage <- DimPlot(seurat.obj, group.by = 'stage_id', shuffle=T)
  p.race <- DimPlot(seurat.obj, group.by = 'Race', shuffle=T)
  p.sex <- DimPlot(seurat.obj, group.by = 'Sex', shuffle=T)
  p.brain.regions <- DimPlot(seurat.obj, group.by = 'Brain.Regions.', shuffle=T)
  p.oxygen <- DimPlot(seurat.obj, group.by = 'Oxygen.No.Oxygen', shuffle=T)
  p.chem <- DimPlot(seurat.obj, group.by = 'chem', shuffle=T)
  p.batch <- DimPlot(seurat.obj, group.by = 'batch', shuffle=T)
  p.annotation_l1 <- DimPlot(seurat.obj, group.by = 'annotation_l1', label=T, shuffle=T, label.size=2)
  p.annotation_l2 <- DimPlot(seurat.obj, group.by = 'annotation_l2', label=T, shuffle=T, label.size=2)
  p.annotation_l3 <- DimPlot(seurat.obj, group.by = 'annotation_l3', label=T, shuffle=T, label.size=2)
  p.low.quality <- DimPlot(seurat.obj, group.by = 'low.quality.by.qc', shuffle=T)
  p.filter.out <- DimPlot(seurat.obj, group.by = 'filter.out', shuffle=T)
  p.pmi <- FeaturePlot(seurat.obj, features = 'PMI', cells=cells.order.random)
  p.percent.mt <- FeaturePlot(seurat.obj, features = 'percent.mt', cells=cells.order.random)
  p.nCount_RNA <- FeaturePlot(seurat.obj, features = 'nCount_RNA', cells=cells.order.random)
  p.nFeature_RNA <- FeaturePlot(seurat.obj, features = 'nFeature_RNA', cells=cells.order.random)
  p.postmortem.signature <- FeaturePlot(seurat.obj, features = 'postmortem.signature', cells=cells.order.random)
  p.heat.shock.signature <- FeaturePlot(seurat.obj, features = 'heat.shock.signature', cells=cells.order.random)
  p.postmortem.sensitive <- FeaturePlot(seurat.obj, features = 'postmortem.sensitive', cells=cells.order.random)
  p.postmortem.glial <- FeaturePlot(seurat.obj, features = 'postmortem.glial', cells=cells.order.random)
  p <- p.library + p.individual + p.stage + p.race + p.sex + p.brain.regions + p.oxygen + p.chem + p.batch +
    p.annotation_l1 + p.annotation_l2 + p.annotation_l3 + p.low.quality + p.filter.out + p.pmi + p.percent.mt + p.nCount_RNA + p.nFeature_RNA + 
    p.postmortem.signature + p.heat.shock.signature + p.postmortem.sensitive + p.postmortem.glial
  
  pdf(paste0(results.dir, 'Herring2022/', clean, '.filtered.UMAP.pdf'), width=36, height=24)
  print(p)
  dev.off()
  
  saveRDS(seurat.obj, paste0(data.dir, 'Herring_2022/', 'processed/', clean, '.all.sampled.merged.filtered.seurat.obj.RDS'))
}

print('done')
```



# CD45+ Satija
```{r}
## create Seurat object from raw data in GEO (Daniel's file and downloaded file don't have raw counts)
counts <- ReadMtx(
  mtx = paste0(data.dir, 'Satija_2021_PBMC/', 'GSE164378_RAW/', 'GSM5008737_RNA_3P-matrix.mtx.gz'), 
  features = paste0(data.dir, 'Satija_2021_PBMC/', 'GSE164378_RAW/', 'GSM5008737_RNA_3P-features.tsv.gz'),
  cells = paste0(data.dir, 'Satija_2021_PBMC/', 'GSE164378_RAW/', 'GSM5008737_RNA_3P-barcodes.tsv.gz')
)

metadata <- read.csv(paste0(data.dir, 'Satija_2021_PBMC/', 'GSE164378_RAW/', 'GSE164378_sc.meta.data_3P.csv'), row.names = 1)

satija2021.ref <- CreateSeuratObject(counts = counts)
satija2021.ref <- NormalizeData(satija2021.ref)
satija2021.ref <- AddMetaData(satija2021.ref, metadata)
satija2021.ref[["percent.mt"]] <- PercentageFeatureSet(satija2021.ref, pattern = "^MT-")

# remove doublets
satija2021.ref <- subset(satija2021.ref, subset = celltype.l2 != "Doublet")

update.cell.type.l2 <- function(x) {
  if (x %in% c("Mono", "DC")) {
    return("Myeloid")
  } else if (x %in% c("CD4 T", "CD8 T", "other T", "B", "NK")) {
    return("Lymphoid")
  } else if (x %in% c("other")) {
    return("Other immune")
  } else {
    stop(paste('unknown cell type', x))
  }
}

update.cell.type.l3 <- function(x) {
  if (x %in% c("Mono", "DC")) {
    return("Myeloid")
  } else if (x %in% c("CD4 T", "CD8 T", "other T")) {
    return("T")
  } else if (x == "B") {
    return("B")
  } else if (x == "NK") {
    return("NK")
  } else if (x %in% c("other")) {
    return("Other immune")
  } else {
    stop(paste('unknown cell type', x))
  }
}

update.cell.type.l4 <- function(x) {
  if (x %in% c("CD14 Mono", "CD16 Mono")) {
    return("Monocytes")
  } else if (x %in% c("pDC", "cDC2", "Eryth", "Platelet", "cDC1", "ASDC")) {
    return("Other myeloid")
  } else if (x %in% c("B intermediate", "B naive", "B memory", "Plasmablast")) {
    return("B")
  } else if (x %in% c("CD4 TCM", "CD4 Naive", "CD4 CTL", "CD4 TEM", "CD4 Proliferating")) {
    return("CD4 T")
  } else if (x %in% c("CD8 Naive", "CD8 TEM", "CD8 TCM", "CD8 Proliferating")) {
    return("CD8 T")
  } else if (x %in% c("Treg", "MAIT", "gdT", "dnT")) {
    return("Other T")
  } else if (x %in% c("NK", "NK_CD56bright", "MAIT", "gdT", "dnT", "NK Proliferating")) {
    return("NK")
  } else if (x %in% c("HSPC", "ILC")) {
    return("Other immune")
  } else {
    stop(paste('unknown cell type', x))
  }
}

satija2021.ref$annotation_l1 <- "Immune"
satija2021.ref$annotation_l2 <- sapply(satija2021.ref$celltype.l1, function(x) update.cell.type.l2(x))
satija2021.ref$annotation_l3 <- sapply(satija2021.ref$celltype.l1, function(x) update.cell.type.l3(x))
satija2021.ref$annotation_l4 <- sapply(satija2021.ref$celltype.l2, function(x) update.cell.type.l4(x))

# very low quality cells 
satija2021.ref$filter.out <- apply(satija2021.ref@meta.data, 1, function(row) (as.numeric(row[['nCount_RNA']]) < nCount_RNA.cutoff.filter.out) | (as.numeric(row[['percent.mt']]) > percent.mt.cutoff.filter.out))

# low quality cells
satija2021.ref$low.quality.by.qc <- apply(satija2021.ref@meta.data, 1, function(row) (as.numeric(row[['nCount_RNA']]) < nCount_RNA.cutoff.low) | (as.numeric(row[['nFeature_RNA']]) < nFeature_RNA.cutoff.low) | (as.numeric(row[['percent.mt']]) > percent.mt.cutoff))


satija2021.ref <- subset(satija2021.ref, subset = (low.quality.by.qc == FALSE) & (filter.out == FALSE))

satija2021.ref <- FindVariableFeatures(satija2021.ref)

# metaprogram scores
satija2021.ref <- add.module.score(satija2021.ref, gene.signatures)

satija2021.ref <- ScaleData(satija2021.ref)

set.seed(123)
satija2021.ref <- RunPCA(satija2021.ref)
ElbowPlot(satija2021.ref, ndims=50)

satija2021.ref <- RunUMAP(satija2021.ref, dims=1:20, return.model=T)

p1 <- DimPlot(satija2021.ref, group.by='celltype.l1', label=T, label.size=4, shuffle = T)
p2 <- DimPlot(satija2021.ref, group.by='celltype.l2', label=T, label.size=2, shuffle = T) + NoLegend()
p3 <- DimPlot(satija2021.ref, group.by='celltype.l3', label=T, label.size=2, shuffle = T) + NoLegend()
p4 <- DimPlot(satija2021.ref, group.by='annotation_l1', label=T, label.size=4, shuffle = T)
p5 <- DimPlot(satija2021.ref, group.by='annotation_l2', label=T, label.size=4, shuffle = T)
p6 <- DimPlot(satija2021.ref, group.by='annotation_l3', label=T, label.size=4, shuffle = T)
p7 <- FeaturePlot(satija2021.ref, features=c('postmortem.signature'), order = T)
p8 <- FeaturePlot(satija2021.ref, features=c('heat.shock.signature'), order = T)
p9 <- FeaturePlot(satija2021.ref, features=c('postmortem.sensitive'), order = T)
p10 <- FeaturePlot(satija2021.ref, features=c('postmortem.glial'), order = T)
p11 <- FeaturePlot(satija2021.ref, features=c('percent.mt'), order = T)
p12 <- DimPlot(satija2021.ref, group.by='filter.out', shuffle = T)
p13 <- DimPlot(satija2021.ref, group.by='low.quality.by.qc', shuffle = T)
p <- p1 + p2 + p3 + p4 + p5 + p6 + p7 + p8 + p9 + p10 + p11 + p12 + p13
pdf(paste0(results.dir, 'HealthyReference/', 'satija2021.healthy.reference.UMAP.pdf'), width=24, height=16)
print(p)
dev.off()


saveRDS(satija2021.ref, paste0(data.dir, 'Satija_2021_PBMC/multi.seurat.obj.RDS'))
```
